entities.summary: Ghana Empire, a political institution in Mauritania during Prehistoric Saharan Mauritania (2000 BCE–500 BCE). Grew from Tichitt Walata Settlement and Green Sahara and Pastoral Communities. Led to the emergence of Sanhaja Berber Nomadic Confederations.
